text:
Ada Park: quick visual handoff for the webinar push  need a compact asset bundle: 1) one-sheet (US Letter PDF) with a dual-metric mini-chart (latency vs $/1k tokens) + tiny 3-step inbound flow, 2) three social tiles (1200x1200 carousel) with panels for latency, cost, and recommended models, 3) landing hero (1600x900) and 600x200 email header. Brand-safe palette only. Deadline: Thu EOD PT. Provide Figma link and exports.
Maria Chen: noted. For the mini-chart, do we prefer axis overlay (dual y) or two small sparklines side-by-side?
Ada Park: try overlay first; if axis labels clash, use side-by-side. Keep the chart austere 1no gradients. Also include a tiny table: top-3 model picks + per-1k token cost.
Priya Rao: sample values for visuals: latency_ms=[36,44,58,71,85], cost_per_1k=[0.48,0.34,0.22,0.14,0.07]. Sparkline alt text under 220 chars: "Sparkline: latency grows from 36ms to 85ms while cost per 1k tokens drops from $0.48 to $0.07 across model variants."
Maria Chen: thanks. Filenames I'll stage: wm_launch_onepager_v1.pdf, wm_carousel_panel1_1200x1200.png, wm_carousel_panel2_1200x1200.png, wm_carousel_panel3_1200x1200.png, wm_hero_1600x900.jpg, wm_emailhdr_600x200.jpg. Figma source: /brand/marketing/wm_launch/visuals.
brand-bot: Brand checklist  confirm primary REDWOOD-500 #B91C1C + neutral greys; fonts Inter (body) + GT Aligned (headings); max 2 typefaces; text contrast >= 4.5:1; export @2x for PNG/JPG and provide SVG for vector diagrams. Internal link: https://brand/redwood-guidelines.
Jordan Li: ops routing requirements: registration form must POST hidden fields campaign=wm_launch_q3, source=webinar, tag=benchkit. When score>=70 -> owner_pool=bench_sales. Also default lead_priority=medium. We need a small mapping CSV from Ops to Sales (I'll send).
Priya Rao: tiny inbound flow to include in one-pager: 3-step horizontal: 1) Register (form) -> 2) Ops scores & qualifies -> 3) Book demo (Sales). Mono-line icons only; provide SVG and PNG.
Maria Chen: accessibility: will add tagged PDF, alt text, and longdesc in metadata. Also will include readable table for screen readers.
Ada Park: footer/legal: include "\u00A9 Redwood Inference 2026" and small note "Internal benchmark summary  Not for external republishing." Keep legal minimal.
Maria Chen: timeline: initial comps by Tue AM, review Tue afternoon, final assets Thu EOD. I'll drop exports into /brand/marketing/wm_launch/exports and ping the channel when ready.
Ada Park: perfect. Also pls add a one-line speaker credit area on the one-pager and a short link to the full benchmark doc. Ping me when comps live.
Priya Rao: copying Sales and Ops in the handoff doc. Will include a short README in the Figma file listing filenames and the SFDC fields.
Maria Chen: will do. Thanks all :sparkles:
